title: Boston Gas Company submits for approval a 365 Day Transportation Agreement with Abbey Landmark Operating L.L.C.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department APPROVES the proposed Transportation Agreement. The Department finds that the pricing terms under the agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefor, GRANTS the Company's request for protection from public disclosure, pursuant to G.L. c. 25 § 5D. Commissioners participating were: Janet Gail Besser, Chair; Commissioners James Connelly, w. Robert Keating, Paul B. Vasington and Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr.
